# m6 contact sheet
# Part 1 of 5 (m6-contact-sheet-1.txt … m6-contact-sheet-5.txt), each at most 180 000 B.
#
# Promise: a real conflict is resolvable without leaving the app — each shape a merge, rebase or stash pop stops on is taken, staged and continued by keys, and the bytes are what the command line's own checkout gives (TESTING.md "Conflicts walk", "Conflict journeys").
#
# Generated by scripts/contact-sheet.sh — do not hand-edit; edit
# m6-contact-sheet-captions.tsv and re-run instead.
#
# 181 captures in all, in ticket order.
#
# These are character-grid captures (pyte/TestBackend), not pixels:
# colour is never verifiable from this file. Judge colour only in a
# real terminal, never from a capture (CLAUDE.md rule 5).
#
# Scroll once: each capture is delimited by a heading naming its
# file (docs/shots/<name>) and what right looks like for it.
